FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Office_Text_Could.en: WARDEN SLOWPOKE came in, but\nI couldn't understand him.\pI think he's got a speech problem!
FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Office_Text_Could.fr: RAMOLOSS m'a parlé, mais je ne\ncomprends rien à c'qu'il m'dit.\pJe crois qu'il a un problème pour\nparler !

FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Office_Text_Nickn.en: We nicknamed the WARDEN\n“SLOWPOKE.”\pYou know, he has that vacant look\nlike a SLOWPOKE.
FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Office_Text_Nickn.fr: Nous avons surnommé le GARDIEN,\nRAMOLOSS.\pBen, oui ! Il ressemble à un\nRAMOLOSS !

FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Office_Text_Prize.en:
WARDEN SLOWPOKE is running a
promotion campaign right now.\pTry to get to the farthest corner
of the SAFARI ZONE.\pIf you can make it, you'll win a
very convenient prize.
FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Office_Text_Prize.fr:
RAMOLOSS vient de lancer une
campagne de promotion.\pEssaie d'aller dans le coin le plus
éloigné du PARC SAFARI.\pSi tu y arrives, tu recevras un
prix.

FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Office_Text_Warde.en: WARDEN SLOWPOKE is very\nknowledgeable about POKéMON.\pHe even has some fossils of rare,\nextinct POKéMON.
FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Office_Text_Warde.fr: RAMOLOSS s'y connaît beaucoup en\nPOKéMON !\pIl a même des fossiles de POKéMON\nrares et anciens !
